title: MAP/BARO Pressure Circuit Malfunction
problem: The Engine Control Unit (ECU) detects an implausible or erratic signal from the MAP/BARO pressure sensor, indicating a general circuit issue.
symptoms: Rough idle; Engine hesitation; Decreased fuel efficiency
actions: Check sensor wiring for damage; Verify sensor voltage output; Replace MAP sensor if faulty
location: Located on the intake manifold or near the throttle body

title: MAP/BARO Pressure Circuit Low Input
problem: The ECU detects a voltage signal from the MAP/BARO sensor that is lower than expected, suggesting a vacuum leak or sensor malfunction.
symptoms: Poor acceleration; Engine may stall; Reduced power
actions: Inspect vacuum lines for leaks; Check MAP sensor wiring for shorts; Test MAP sensor output
location: Located on the intake manifold or near the throttle body

title: MAP/BARO Pressure Circuit High Input
problem: The ECU detects a voltage signal from the MAP/BARO sensor that is higher than expected, suggesting high pressure or a wiring issue.
symptoms: Rough idle; Engine hesitation; Excessive fuel consumption
actions: Check MAP sensor wiring for shorts or corrosion; Test MAP sensor output voltage; Replace MAP sensor if faulty
location: Located on the intake manifold or near the throttle body

title: IAT Sensor Circuit Malfunction

symptoms: Poor cold starting; Incorrect fuel-air mixture; Reduced engine performance

title: IAT Sensor Circuit High Input

symptoms: Rough idle; Rich fuel mixture; Decreased fuel economy
actions: Check IAT sensor wiring for open circuits; Test sensor resistance at ambient temperature; Replace IAT sensor if faulty
location: Located in the airbox or intake tract

title: ECT Sensor Circuit Malfunction

title: ECT Sensor Circuit High Input
